story.intent: Move slow conversation work to session-owned async tools.
story.behaviorBefore: Callers and continuation routes owned synchronous tool execution.
story.behaviorAfter: Async session runtime owns execution, tracing, cancellation, and cleanup.

chapters.title: Async tool contract and lifecycle
chapters.whyItMatters: Every runtime and caller relies on this contract.
exitCriteria: The async contract is internally coherent.

chapters.title: Session runtime and resource ownership
chapters.whyItMatters: Leaks or double cleanup cross request boundaries.

visits.reason: Review cleanup separately in the shared file.

exitCriteria: Every terminal path releases resources once.

chapters.title: Graph bridge and turn tracing
chapters.objective: Follow async state through the graph adapter.
chapters.whyItMatters: Trace identity must survive graph boundaries.
chapters.priorityReason: It connects runtime state to orchestration.
exitCriteria: Graph calls preserve session and turn identity.

chapters.title: Web and placard search execution
chapters.whyItMatters: External calls now run under async lifecycle rules.
chapters.priorityReason: It exercises the new runtime with external I/O.

chapters.title: Routing and continuation removal
chapters.objective: Verify retired continuation paths have no surviving callers.
chapters.priorityReason: Deletion safety depends on caller migration.
reviewQuestions: Are all old entry points retired?
exitCriteria: No reachable caller depends on continuation routing.

chapters.title: Worker shutdown and cancellation
chapters.whyItMatters: In-flight tasks must terminate without leaks.
chapters.priorityReason: Terminal behavior has production blast radius.
exitCriteria: Shutdown leaves no owned task running.

chapters.title: End-to-end regression evidence
chapters.whyItMatters: Unit tests cannot prove the complete execution path.
exitCriteria: Evidence covers the primary changed flow.

chapters.title: Supporting documentation and migration notes
chapters.whyItMatters: Operators and future callers rely on this contract description.
reviewQuestions: Does documentation describe the final contract?
exitCriteria: Guidance matches the final runtime behavior.
